data.h1: M-340 Titanium Dioxide for Plastics and Masterbatch Evaluation
hero_paragraphs: M-340 uses inorganic and organic treatment and is documented with dispersibility, bluish undertone, whiteness, high-temperature anti-yellowing and stable film-production directions. Review the technical index below and confirm suitability through testing in your own formulation, processing and end-use conditions.

data.positioning_title: Where M-340 Fits in Product Evaluation
positioning_paragraphs: M-340 is a rutile titanium dioxide pigment produced by the chloride process for plastics evaluation.

Its documented public profile combines inorganic and organic treatment with approved application directions in high-concentration masterbatch, films, silk and wire plastics, injection plastics and moderate-durability plastics. Use M-340 as a candidate when dispersion, color direction, whiteness, heat exposure and production stability are relevant. Final Grade selection should account for resin, additive package, pigment loading, processing temperature, equipment, end-use conditions and destination-document requirements.

data.applications_title: Plastics and Masterbatch Directions to Evaluate

applications.title: High-Concentration Masterbatch
applications.text: Evaluate M-340 at the intended pigment loading and carrier-resin system. Confirm dispersion, color direction, processing behavior and downstream dilution performance under the actual masterbatch conditions.

applications.title: High-Quality Films
applications.text: Review M-340 in the intended film formulation and production line. Confirm dispersion, film appearance, processing stability and performance at the required thickness and operating conditions.

applications.title: Silk and Wire Plastics
applications.text: Include M-340 in testing for the source-listed silk and wire plastics direction. Confirm pigment dispersion, processing behavior, appearance and suitability in the buyer’s specific polymer and production process.

applications.title: Injection Plastics
applications.text: Evaluate M-340 in injection-moulded plastic formulations using the actual resin, additives, pigment loading, processing temperature and moulding conditions.

applications.title: Moderate-Durability Plastics
applications.text: Review M-340 for plastic applications whose qualification target includes the source-listed moderate-durability direction. Confirm the required service performance through end-use testing.

data.evaluation_title: What to Evaluate in Your Plastics Formulation

evaluation.title: Dispersion and Appearance Review
items: Dispersibility at the intended pigment loading and mixing conditions
Bluish-undertone direction in the complete formulation
Film appearance and production stability where film processing applies

evaluation.title: Heat and End-Use Qualification
items: High-temperature anti-yellowing direction at the intended processing temperature
Compatibility with the selected resin and additive package
Masterbatch, film, injection or wire/silk plastics processing conditions, as applicable
End-use durability target, destination requirements and sample-validation results
